description: False-colour aerial imagery showing a section of the Var River in the Alps Maritimes, France, illustrating characteristics of river banks and beds for land cover classification. The image is credited to Eurostat, LUCAS. In this false-colour composite, dense vegetation appears in shades of dark red, while areas with sparser vegetation or agricultural land are lighter red to pink. The main river channel and its braided network, including active water flow and exposed sand or gravel bars, are depicted in shades of dark blue (water) and light blue-grey (sediment/bare ground). The image highlights the definition of "Sand and gravel of river banks including accumulation of material at bars and floodplain" with "Little or no vegetation ($< 10\%$)" as per Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) guidelines. Surrounding the river system are extensive vegetated areas. Small, light-coloured structures, possibly buildings, are visible within the vegetated zones.
